subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should maintainers accept this shared Unix process-cleanup contract change with the current detached-caller audit, or require broader live launchd proof before merge?
rationale: The patch has no concrete contributor-facing blocker, but a wrong process-group override can either terminate the gateway process group or leave detached descendants running, which needs owner acceptance.

options.title: Land after process-owner review
options.body: Accept the caller audit and merge this PR as the canonical fix once branch freshness requirements are satisfied.

options.title: Request launchd scenario proof
options.body: Ask for a macOS launchd-managed gateway run that exercises the linked Telegram-triggered failure path before merging.

options.title: Narrow uncertain overrides
options.body: Remove or rework any `detached:true` caller whose process-group ownership is not maintainer-confirmed.

recommendation.title: Land after process-owner review
recommendation.body: Accept the caller audit and merge this PR as the canonical fix once branch freshness requirements are satisfied.
